title: Invoice

pending.note: Marked as paid — the confirmation receipt goes to the customer once the clearance window passes (due {{when}} UTC). Unmark before then to silently revert; nothing has been sent.
pending.unmarkConfirm: Unmark this payment? Nothing has been sent to the customer — the invoice quietly returns to unpaid.
pending.receiptNotSent: Payment confirmed, but the receipt could not be sent — use “Email invoice” to send it now.
pending.manualNote: Marked paid by {{method}} — awaiting confirmation that the money arrived. This does NOT auto-confirm; confirm it below when the payment lands.
pending.confirmReceivedConfirm: Confirm this payment arrived? The invoice becomes confirmed-paid and the receipt is sent to the customer.

paidLocked: This invoice is paid and locked. Only an admin can unlock it for corrections.
unlockConfirm: Unlock this invoice for corrections? Its frozen lines are removed and it drops out of your figures until it is re-issued or re-paid. The action is recorded in the audit trail.

email.subject: Invoice {{number}} from {{garage}}
email.body: Please find attached invoice {{number}} from {{garage}} for {{total}}.

datePaid.label: Date paid (on the document)
datePaid.error: Could not save the paid date.

dateIssued.label: Date issued (on the document)
dateIssued.error: Could not save the issue date.

frozenNote: This document is frozen — the lines locked when the invoice was raised. An admin can unlock it to make corrections.
unlockedNote: UNLOCKED FOR CORRECTION — this invoice’s lines are not frozen and it currently contributes nothing to your figures. Correct the estimate on the job card, then re-issue (or mark paid) to freeze it again.
voidNotice: This invoice was voided on {{when}} and is not payable. Reason: {{reason}}

void.title: Void this invoice
void.reasonPlaceholder: This is the record that explains the gap in the numbering — write what actually happened.
void.addReconstruction: Note that the lines are a reconstruction
void.reconstructionNote: The original line snapshot was destroyed by an admin unlock, so the retained lines are rebuilt from the job card as it stood.
void.confirmIntro: Voiding does not delete anything. This is what will be kept:
void.keepNumber: Invoice number {{number}} — kept, exactly as issued
void.keepTotal: The total, {{total}} — kept on the document
void.keepLines: All {{count}} line(s) — kept, frozen as they are
void.keepConsumed: {{number}} stays consumed. It is never reused, and the sequence keeps the gap — which is why the reason above matters.
void.confirmReasonLabel: This will be recorded against the invoice:
void.amendIntro: The original wording is kept and stays on the record. This adds a corrected version beside it.
void.amendError: Could not amend the void reason.

amendedNotice: This invoice was amended on {{when}} and replaces the version previously issued for {{from}}. It keeps the same invoice number.
amendedCount: Amended {{n}} times since it was first issued.
